verdict.rationale: Featurebase's webhooks explicitly react to 'status changes' and its workflow engine can automate follow-on actions, giving product managers the building blocks to notify customers when a feature's status changes, but the evidence never shows a native, one-click 'notify subscribers on status change' email feature — it implies this requires wiring up webhooks/workflows rather than a built-in notification toggle. Missing for 10: direct documentation of an out-of-the-box customer-facing status-change email/notification feature and confirmation of end-to-end delivery without external tooling.
